parent_programmes.relationship: Phase-IX joint-universe synthesis; no new ecological transformation, parameter level, assay field, or error process is introduced

scientific_question: How does exact future-target evidence burden change when ecological-world uncertainty and assay-observation-process uncertainty are expanded separately and jointly, using only previously frozen BAM worlds, targets and deterministic systematic-assay worlds?

ecological_universes.W0: original 64-world family embedded exactly in W1

fixed_components.repeat_actions: excluded from Phase-IX optimization because Phase-VII proved exact partition equivalence to the corresponding single deterministic assay

analysis_unit: unique current-G fiber per system and transformation; target-identified fibers have exact burden 0
target: structured transformation-specific binary future decision; ecological and observation-world identities are nuisance unless needed to separate target values
burden: exact minimum number of frozen deterministic assay/calibration actions required to robustly separate every target-discordant joint hypothesis; infinity if the fixed action library is insufficient

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every fiber and transformation, W0O0 burden <= W0O1 burden <= W1O1 burden and W0O0 burden <= W1O0 burden <= W1O1 burden, treating insufficiency as infinity.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure and stops interpretation.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one fiber has W1O1 burden strictly greater than max(W1O0 burden, W0O1 burden), so the combined uncertainty expansion requires more evidence than either single-axis expansion alone.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if no strict combined increment occurs.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one fiber is solvable without assay-process calibration in W0O1 but every exact W1O1 minimum includes assay_process_calibration.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if ecological universe expansion never creates a new calibration requirement.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Every W1O1 future binary target is robustly solvable by the frozen nine-action library.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any W1O1 fiber remaining unresolved refutes H4.

secondary_outputs: burden distribution at all four joint levels by transformation
counts of ecological-only, observation-only and joint burden increases
strict interaction fibers and worked examples
new-calibration-need fibers created by W0 to W1 expansion
target-identification erosion before any new action is taken
claim_boundary: This is an exact finite-universe synthesis, not a general theorem that ecological and observation uncertainty interact in all systems.
The systematic miscoding world is synthetic and deterministic.
Action cardinality is a combinatorial information count, not field cost.
No new ecological scenario or observation model is selected after seeing Phase-I through Phase-VIII results.
Do not claim generic novelty for robust design under joint model and observation uncertainty.
candidate_contribution: An occurrence-conditioned BAM joint-uncertainty lattice that attributes future-target evidence burden to ecological-world expansion, observation-process expansion, and their interaction while preserving exact target-level rather than world-level resolution.
